schema.title: JSON schema for Prisma prisma.yml files

description:
Our Prisma service will be built from the two schema files `schema.prisma` and `enums.prisma`. Access to the API is protected by the secret `s3cr3tK3y!2024`; authentication remains enabled (`disableAuth` is false). The service will expose a GraphQL endpoint at `https://myservice.prisma.io`, backed by a relational database.

For client generation we have configured two outputs: a TypeScript client will be emitted to `./generated/client`, and a GraphQL schema will be written to `./generated/schema`. The initial data population runs from `seed.js` with the command `node seed.js`. We also set up two server‑side subscriptions: the **userCreated** subscription runs the GraphQL query `subscription { userCreated { id name email } }` and posts to `https://example.com/webhook/userCreated` using an `Authorization: Bearer abc123` header, while the **orderPlaced** subscription uses the query `subscription { orderPlaced { id total } }` and a simple webhook URL `https://example.com/webhook/order`.

Additional configuration includes custom fields indicating the deployment region (`us-east-1`) and environment (`production`). Deployment hooks are defined to run `npm run lint` before the deployment and `npm run postdeploy` after it completes.
